title: Mosaic rollout checklist and deckhand log
body:
Purpose:
This doc captures a compact, operational checklist for the "mosaic" patch sprint rollout, plus a lightweight 'deckhand' log for shift leads steering the traffic. Intended for a 48h staged roll with a tight canary bakeoff and explicit rollback gates.

Summary rollout plan (high level):
- Day 0 (preflight): final smoke, perf baseline snapshot, traffic snapshot capture.
- Day 1 (canary bakeoff): 1% -> 5% -> 10% over 6h windows with 30m hangouts for metrics review.
- Day 2 (ramp & stabilize): 25% -> 50% -> 100% with staggered regional lanes (NA/EU/APAC).

Quick checklist (preflight):
- [ ] Merge release branch and tag (PR #1214 merged).
- [ ] Generate artifact hash and push to staging registry.
- [ ] Run full smoke suite on staging (smoke-id: mosaic-2028-05-02).
- [ ] Capture baseline 95th/99th latency and error-rate (A/B snapshot).
- [ ] Ensure alerting pages are up-to-date and on-call roster confirmed.
- [ ] Prepare customer comms blurb (draft below).

Canary bakeoff schedule (recommended windows):
- T+00:00 start canary at 1% for 2h (quick sanity + flamegraph check).
- T+02:00 if green, move to 5% for 3h (kv-cache hit ratio, latency p95 within +15%).
- T+05:00 if green, 10% for 4h with full QA traffic (simulated long-context workloads).
- T+09:00 hold for extended telemetry review and decision to continue.

Metrics/acceptance gates (per window):
- p95 latency change <= +20% absolute vs baseline OR absolute p95 < 350ms (whichever is stricter).
- error-rate (5xx + downstream timeouts) increase <= 0.5 percentage points absolute.
- token throughput within expected range and no KV-cache eviction storms.
- no new spike in RL infra queues or memory GC tail events.

Rollback matrix (quick):
- If any gate violated in current window, pause rollout and revert traffic to previous variant.
- If repeated gate violation in consecutive windows or regional-only violation with customer impact, trigger full rollback and hotfix branch.
- Rollback command: ops/rollbacks/roller --env prod --model mosaic:v2028-05-02 --target previous-stable. (see runbook link)
